name: MithrilUI Full
$comment: Everything in `default`, plus the catch-all: assets no named rule
recognises are cleared to transparent instead of left alone.
This is the flattest the skin gets, and the least predictable. Roughly
450 assets are affected whose names say nothing about what they draw, so
some of them will be things you wanted. Known casualties found this way
so far: the player portrait plate, several toolbar buttons and the
loading screen progress bar -- all since given named rules or exclusions.
Worth running if you enjoy a maximally bare interface and will report
